title: Unicorn dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="58" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#ffd1dc"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M48 48 Q46 36 50 30 L58 34 Q54 42 58 48 Z" fill="#ffc4d0"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="27" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#ffd1dc"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="30" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#ffb8c8"/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <path d="M48 20 L45 12 L52 18 Z" fill="#ffaec0"/>
  <!-- Horn -->
  <path d="M54 17 L58 4 L62 17 Z" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <path d="M55 17 L58 7 L61 17 Z" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="57" cy="25" r="2.5" fill="#5a3e8e"/>
  <circle cx="57.8" cy="24.3" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx="64" cy="30" r="0.8" fill="#d17a95"/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d="M46 22 Q40 26 42 32 Q36 34 40 40 Q34 42 38 48" stroke="#ff7eb3" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 20 Q38 24 40 30" stroke="#ff5fa2" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="34" y="68" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffd1dc"/>
  <rect x="62" y="68" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffd1dc"/>
  <!-- Dancing raised legs -->
  <rect x="40" y="62" width="6" height="14" rx="3" transform="rotate(-25 43 62)" fill="#ffb8c8"/>
  <rect x="58" y="62" width="6" height="14" rx="3" transform="rotate(25 61 62)" fill="#ffb8c8"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M30 56 Q22 48 24 40 Q20 44 22 52 Q18 50 20 58" stroke="#ff7eb3" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 54 Q20 50 22 42" stroke="#ff5fa2" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="34" y="82" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c77a90"/>
  <rect x="62" y="82" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c77a90"/>
  <!-- Sparkles around -->
  <path d="M78 20 L79 24 L83 25 L79 26 L78 30 L77 26 L73 25 L77 24 Z" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <path d="M22 30 L23 33 L26 34 L23 35 L22 38 L21 35 L18 34 L21 33 Z" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <path d="M80 50 L81 53 L84 54 L81 55 L80 58 L79 55 L76 54 L79 53 Z" fill="#b0e0ff"/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d="M68 12 Q68 9 71 9 Q74 9 74 12 Q74 15 71 17 Q68 15 68 12 Z" fill="#ff5fa2"/>
</svg>
